args.title: Handle CRLF line endings in CSV parser
args.body: File: src/ingest/parser.ts. The parser splits input only on "\n", so files with Windows-style CRLF line endings (as now produced by finance's new export tool) leave a trailing "\r" on the last field of each line, including the header. This makes the last header column (e.g. "description\r") fail to match REQUIRED_COLUMNS, triggering the "Malformed row" error on row 1 even though the columns are correct. Fix by splitting on /\r?\n/ (or stripping a trailing "\r" from each line) before parsing the header and rows.
